content.text:
The bug was in `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py`. It used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Float error turned `19.99 * 100` into `1998.9999…`, so it became 1998. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`.

All 5 tests now pass, including the 3 that were failing in `tests/test_totals.py`. I ran the full suite with `python -m pytest -q`.

I didn't touch any other file. `round` uses banker's rounding on exact ties, but a float input from a price like `19.99` is never an exact tie, so that only matters if amounts ever carry more than two decimal places.
